name: DJ TechTools Midi Fighter Twister
description: 16 encoders x 4 hardware banks. Encoder turns on ch1 (CC = knob + 16 * bank), encoder switches on ch2 with the same CC numbers, side buttons and bank switches on ch4. The 16 knobs control the Perform view's visible 4x4 knob grid: bank 1 shows Deck A and Deck B (each a pinned SRC row over a pinned FX row), bank 2 shows Deck BG and Deck PV the same way, bank 3 shows Master MIX, Master FX, Transitions and FX Wet/Dry, and bank 4 shows the MASTER page (Master, Transitions, FX Wet/Dry, Clock & Global). Pages are set by `banks.pages`; see library/perform_pages for adding your own. Rings show each knob's value and the LEDs take the row colour (dark for a bypassed or empty slot); the lights are written to the bank that is showing. Switch tap = primary action (FX slot bypass / reset to default); shift + tap = secondary (focus FX slot, leave focus, next parameter page); turn while holding the switch = fine. Side buttons navigate: in the Perform view the left-top button is back and the right-top opens the Library; in the Library view left-top is back, right-top steps the tab, right-bottom steps the list, knob 1 is the cursor (turn = step, tap = load or apply, shift + tap = add to the A/B queue), and shift + the side buttons add to the BG queue and step the tab and list backwards. In the Perform view right-bottom opens the picker of the last-touched knob's row; in a picker knob 1 is the cursor, right-top steps the category and shift + right-bottom clears the slot. Encoders must be set to relative in Midi Fighter Utility ("ENC 3FH/41H", binary offset: clockwise sends 65, counter-clockwise 63). For the factory absolute mode, use a copy of this profile with mode ABSOLUTE.
